bugs.error_message: Settings page shows wrong/stale version (1.0.0 hardcoded)
bugs.root_cause: preferences.xml hardcoded android:summary="1.0.0" for the version preference, while the actual app versionName is generated at build time from `git describe --tags --always --dirty` in app/build.gradle.kts. The two never tracked.
bugs.fix: Removed hardcoded summary from preferences.xml. In SettingsFragment.onCreatePreferences, set the version preference summary at runtime via PackageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, 0) -> versionName + longVersionCode.
